text:
maria: quick favor — need a microbench for function-calling overhead when streaming + structured output. trying to get a baseline for regressions before the next rollout. can someone run: non-streaming vs streaming, with and without function/tool call, and with structured JSON output schema turned on/off?

akash: i can take this. which models + payload shapes do you want?

maria: thanks! primary target is rwd-medium-2 (cpu/GPU perf mixed). run two seq lengths: short prompt (~50 tokens) and long (~512). also measure cold vs warm kv cache. metrics: per-token p50/p95 latency, end-to-end call overhead (ms), extra bytes sent, and gpu%/cpu% during run.

zane: include a small stubbed tool call (200ms simulated work) and a larger one (1s). should show cost of blocking tool sync vs streaming.

akash: got it. rough command i'll use (local harness):

```bash
python -m perf_harness.run 
  --model rwd-medium-2 
  --mode streaming,nonstreaming 
  --func-call stubs/200ms,stubs/1s 
  --structured-schema tests/schemas/simple_person.json 
  --seq-lens 50,512 
  --cold-warm both 
  --batch-sizes 1,4 
  --reps 200
```

leo: please also dump nvprof/kernels summary and a flame graph for the 512 runs if possible. that'll help us find any kernel-level regressions when streaming is on.

akash: will do nvprof for a subset (512, streaming, funccall 1s). might need sudo; i'll push artifacts to the perf bucket.

perf-bot: baseline snapshot found: rwd-medium-2 nonstreaming short/cold: p50=12ms p95=35ms; streaming short/cold: p50=18ms p95=60ms; baseline collected 2026-01-12. artifact: https://perf.redwood.internal/snapshots/20260112/rwd-medium-2.json :robot_face:

maria: perfect — include perf-bot baseline in the report and compare. also note any changes in tokenization overhead when schema validation is enabled.

zane: small note: structured output currently adds ~1.5-2.5ms token processing in our last run because of extra postprocessing. worth tracking in the report.

akash: started run now, estimated ~3h for full matrix. i'll post partial numbers as they appear. tagging @leo for nvprof help if i hit permission issues.

leo: on it; shout if you need sudo. also can add a quick PR to perf harness to auto-attach kernel dumps to artifacts.

maria: thanks team. can we get a short summary (1-paragraph) and CSV of raw metrics by EOD tomorrow? this is blocking the canary decision. :pray:

akash: yes — aiming to upload CSV + flamegraphs by 1769503420 (tomorrow EOD PST). uploading initial short-run numbers now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

(perf-bot): initial partial results uploaded: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1769501123/partial.tar.gz

maria: nice. once full results are in i'll open a quick PR in infra/perf with a regression check that fails CI if p95 increases by >15% vs baseline.

zane: +1, also add a flag to only run the heavy 512 NVPROF step on nightly to avoid CI slowdowns.

akash: noted. will annotate artifacts with tags: streaming/nonstreaming, structured_on/off, func_200ms/1s, cold/warm.

maria: great. tagging @eng-runtime for awareness. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
